label: Low distress, highly educated male profile
summary: This profile is characterized by comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms across the measured indicators.

behavior_markers: Reports relatively low loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure.
Shows low average depressive symptom levels on the PHQ-9.
Shows very low average anxiety symptom levels on the GAD-7.
Represents a lower-distress respondent pattern overall.
Most strongly anchored demographically by being male and highly educated.
tone: Stable, low-distress, and psychologically well-adjusted overall.
